description: See people for who they are not what you wish them to be and move accordingly. #selflove #selfcare
transcript: Stop trying to diagnose people and label them. See them for exactly who they are. Many people are mad, sad, arrogant, and unsure of who they are and where they are going. I give grace because I understand the process of evolution. I understand the process of living. I understand the process of being a human. So I will always give grace. I see things for what they are and I move accordingly. It is not my job to make excuses for people by adding labels and diagnosing them.
